hero.title: Summer Courses in Sweden for Indian Students
paras: **Summer Courses in Sweden** are an excellent option for students who want to gain international learning experience, explore Swedish culture, improve their language skills or study a specialised subject during the summer break. Swedish universities and educational institutions offer short-term programmes in areas such as sustainability, language, culture, society, business, technology and the environment.

highlights.title: World-Class Nordic Innovation
highlights.desc: Study in Sweden's globally ranked universities renowned for pioneering scientific breakthroughs, design thinking, and sustainable research.

highlights.title: English-Taught Degrees
highlights.desc: Over 1,000 bachelor's and master's degree programs delivered entirely in English with international accreditation.

highlights.title: Generous Post-Study Work
highlights.desc: Sweden offers residence permits after graduation for students to seek employment or start innovative businesses.

highlights.title: High Quality of Life
highlights.desc: Ranked among the top nations globally for safety, equality, environmental sustainability, and student well-being.

overview: Summer study allows international students to experience the Swedish education system without committing to a full bachelor's or master's degree. However, some programmes are exclusively available to exchange students from partner universities, while others have separate eligibility and admission requirements.
Through **Edu Hawk worldwide** study abroad guidance, students can explore language-learning options and understand the eligibility, fees and application requirements.

universities.name: \. University of Jönköping
universities.desc: The **Youth Summer School** is scheduled from **5 July to 30 July 2027** and introduces students aged 16–18 to sustainable development in Sweden while helping them develop their English-language skills. The programme includes cultural activities, study visits and field trips. ![][image1] Students should check the university's official summer school webpage for updated application details, programme fees and admission requirements.

universities.name: \. Linköping University
universities.desc: The **LiU Summer Academy** offers short summer courses, including *Sweden: Language, Culture and Society*. The summer programme takes place in July and is open only to students nominated by eligible partner universities who meet the academic requirements. ![][image2] Applicants should check the official Summer Academy webpage for current programme dates, eligibility conditions and application deadlines.

universities.name: \. Malmö University
universities.desc: Malmö University offers courses in **Swedish Language, Culture and Society** for students interested in learning basic Swedish communication skills and understanding everyday life in Sweden. The introductory course has a summer study period scheduled from **28 June to 15 August 2027**. The published full tuition fee is **SEK 18,000 (approximately ₹1.71 lakh)**. Students should verify the latest course availability, fee and application information on the university's official course webpage. ![][image3]

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Summer Courses in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, Indian students with qualifying credentials meeting English language proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) and academic prerequisites can apply to recognized universities in Sweden.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Summer Courses in Sweden?
items.a: Most master's and international bachelor's degree programmes are taught entirely in English for international students across Swedish universities.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Summer Courses in Sweden?
items.a: Tuition fees for international students generally range between SEK 80,000 and SEK 150,000 per year, depending on the institution and level of study.

items.q: Can international students work while studying in Sweden?
items.a: Yes, non-EU international students holding a valid Swedish residence permit for higher education are permitted to work alongside their studies without a fixed hours limitation during term time.
